Live: Trump, Putin, Xi unite in China's Shenzhen ahead of historic trilateral meetAPEC Summit 2026 Live: In an unprecedented diplomatic moment, US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are set to hold their first-ever trilateral meeting on Thursday on the sidelines of the APEC summit in China's Shenzhen, with the Ukraine conflict, the Iran war, nuclear arms reduction and artificial intelligence expected to dominate discussions. The historic meeting brings together the leaders of the world's three major powers amid escalating global conflicts and concerns over the future of international security and arms control. They are also expected to discuss how major powers can work together to improve the global situation. The high-stakes diplomatic engagement comes after Trump arrived in China's high-tech city of Shenzhen from Manila on Wednesday to attend the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, which began the same day. In a striking departure from diplomatic protocol, Xi personally received Trump at the airport, welcoming him with a hug in a rare display of physical affection by the Chinese leader. The reception was particularly significant as it marked the first time a Chinese leader had personally welcomed a visiting head of state at the airport since Mao Zedong greeted Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev nearly seven decades ago. The warm reception stood in contrast to Putin's arrival earlier in Shenzhen. The Russian President was received by Cai Qi, a close associate of Xi. Chinese officials described even this as a rare gesture, given that senior party leaders do not usually receive visiting state leaders at airports. The three leaders were also seen exchanging light-hearted banter at the gala dinner for leaders attending the summit. Follow indiatoday.in for live updates
